main_subject.style: joyful adventure-cinema action portrait with natural skin and water texture

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a vertical 2:3 cinematic action portrait of an adult woman moving through a breaking ocean wave during golden hour. She wears a black wetsuit and laughs with wet windblown hair and eyes partly closed as sea spray crosses her face. Use an immersive eye-level close-up beside the moving water, with both arms extended in a released joyful gesture. Include crisp suspended droplets, a streaked ocean horizon, and a low golden sun softened by motion. Light with low 4300K backlight passing through the spray and reflected-water fill on her face. Shoot on a Sony A1 with a 35mm f/1.4 lens at f/2.2 and 1/1600s, preserving raw adventure-cinema color, fine grain, natural skin texture, and realistic wave detail. No text, logo, watermark, or sexualized framing.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, minor, child, sexualized pose, distorted hands, duplicated limbs, blurry face, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, heavy CGI water, text, watermark, logo
